themes.name: Account bans and login lockouts
themes.definition: Accounts banned, under review, not verified, logged out or unable to open; not general app bugs.
themes.effort_reason: Needs changes to trust-and-safety review and appeal processes, not just code.

themes.name: Bugs, crashes and slowness
themes.definition: The app crashes, stops, freezes, loads or downloads slowly, or calls are unstable; not account bans.
themes.effort_reason: Needs debugging across devices, networks and releases.

themes.name: Removed or changed features
themes.definition: Complaints that an existing feature was removed or changed for the worse (edit option, pins, reaction bar).
themes.effort_reason: Usually a setting or rollback of a recent change.

themes.name: New feature requests
themes.definition: Asks for capabilities the app does not have (live video, privacy controls, backup recovery, image quality).
themes.effort_reason: New features need design, build and privacy review.

themes.name: Ads in the app
themes.definition: Complaints about advertising inside the app.
themes.effort_reason: A commercial decision on ad placement and frequency.

themes.name: General dissatisfaction
themes.definition: Negative views of the app or company with no specific problem named.
themes.effort_reason: Needs research to find the specific cause.

themes.name: What users like
themes.definition: Positive comments on ease of use, reliability, staying connected, privacy or cost.
